Anjans celebrates Victory Day
2018-12-11T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/check-it-out/news/anjans-celebrates-victory-day-1671751

Anjans is introducing its latest line, keeping in mind the upcoming Victory Day. The illustrations in the line include commemorative stamps, poems, and pictures related to the Liberation War, as well as images of water lilies and the Jatiyo Sriti Shoudho; all in colours of red and green.

The collection includes saris, panjabis, tops, shalwar-kameezs, t-shirts and more. The line also has children's wear which is made up of panjabis, saris, and t-shirts, amongst others.
